titolo: Your email, turned into what you need to do
sottotitolo: Actions, things you are waiting on and replies — each one linked to the emails it comes from.
requisiti: You’ll need a Gmail account and an OpenRouter API key.

informativa.lettura: We read and send your Gmail only with your permission, also while you’re away, and store it encrypted.
informativa.modelli: Email text goes to AI models through OpenRouter with your own key, only to providers that keep no data.
informativa.invio: Nothing is sent without your explicit confirmation.
informativa.nonVerificata: During the pilot Google shows an “unverified app” screen: this is expected.
